title: Towards a Measure of Individual Fairness for Deep Learning
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspect of faith or religion.
models_tested: A simple neural network with two fully-connected hidden layers
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion or faith. The study focuses on fairness related to protected attributes like race and gender in the Adult dataset.
references: Adult dataset (uci machine learning repository). https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/ datasets/adult.
